info.description: Reusable background and container styling for sections

backgroundStyle.description: Section background style: solid (default bg-background), transparent (no background with gradient), muted (subtle grey bg-muted/30), bordered (primary-colored border with gradient), theme-subtle (light theme gradient - great continuity with borders), theme-muted (stronger theme color)

pattern.description: Optional background pattern overlay (dots, grid, lines, etc.)

gradient.description: Enable gradient effects for the background

containerStyle.description: Content container style: default (no border), bordered (theme-colored border with gradient background - makes content stand out)

containerWidth.description: Container width: default (max-w-7xl), narrow (max-w-4xl), wide (max-w-screen-2xl), full (w-full)

padding.description: Section padding: default (py-16 md:py-24), compact (py-8 md:py-12), spacious (py-24 md:py-32), none (no padding)
